CLAREMONT CITY COUNCIL
  MEETING AGENDA
  “We are a vibrant, livable, and inclusive community dedicated to quality services,
  safety, financial strength, sustainability, preservation, and progress
  with equal representation for our community.”

City Council Chamber  Tuesday
225 Second Street  May 28, 2024
Claremont, CA 91711
  6:30 PM

  COUNCILMEMBERS

  SAL MEDINA
  MAYOR

  JED LEANO  ED REECE  COREY CALAYCAY  JENNIFER STARK

Meetings are open to the public for in-person attendance. The meeting will be live streamed via Zoom,
technology permitting. Members of the public will not be able to provide public comment via Zoom. To
watch the meeting via Zoom, use the following link: https://zoom.us/j/256208090. To listen via telephone
dial (213)338-8477, Webinar ID: 256 208 090. The recorded meeting will be uploaded to the City
website and archived.

  OPTIONS FOR PUBLIC COMMENT

Public comment may be provided by one of the following methods. Each speaker will be given up to
three (3) minutes to provide their comment.

  IN-PERSON LIVE COMMENTS

When the item you wish to speak to is announced, please proceed to the speaker’s podium one by one.

  E-MAIL/MAIL

Written comments sent to the City Clerk’s office will be distributed to the City Council and imaged into
the record of the meeting. Email: sdesautels@ci.claremont.ca.us, jcostanza@ci.claremont.ca.us. Mail:
PO Box 880, Claremont, CA 91711. Written comments submitted after publication of the agenda will be
made available in the document archive system on the City website as soon as possible -
www.ci.claremont.ca.us.

  For assistance, comments, or more information please contact the City Clerk’s Office:
  (909) 399-5461 or (909) 399-5463.

CALL TO ORDER THE MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
 Page 2  City Council Agenda  May 28, 2024

MOMENT OF SILENCE

ROLL CALL

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

CEREMONIAL MATTERS, PRESENTATIONS, AND ANNOUNCEMENTS

Announcement:

  Claremont Helen Renwick Library Updates

FEDERAL HOLIDAYS AND OBSERVANCES

Holidays This Month and Upcoming

  Memorial Day, May 27, 2024

MAYOR AND COUNCIL

Council Items

Council Assignment Reports
City Councilmembers may serve as representatives on regional organizations. This time is
allocated for reports about their activities. For information about the Council's local,
intergovernmental  and  regional  appointments  please  visit  the  City website :
www.ci.claremont.ca.us/government/city-council/city-council-assignments-and-appointments.

CITY MANAGER REPORT

PUBLIC COMMENT
The Council has set aside this time for persons who wish to comment on items that are not listed
on the agenda, but are within the jurisdiction of the City Council. Members of the public will have
the opportunity to address the City Council regarding all items on the agenda at the time the
Council considers those items.

General public comment will be taken for 30 minutes and will resume later in the meeting if there
are speakers who did not get an opportunity to speak because of the 30-minute time limit.

The Brown Act prohibits the City Council from taking action on oral requests relating to items that
are not on the agenda. The Council may engage in a brief discussion, refer the matter to staff,
and/or schedule requests for consideration at a subsequent meeting.

CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed on the Consent Calendar are considered routine. The City Council may act on
these items by one motion following public comment. Only Councilmembers may pull an item from
the Consent Calendar for discussion, reading of resolutions and ordinances will be waived.
 Page 3  City Council Agenda  May 28, 2024

1.  ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING THE CITY WARRANT REGISTERS
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, ALLOWING
  CERTAIN CLAIMS AND DEMANDS AND SPECIFYING THE FUNDS OUT
  OF WHICH THE SAME ARE TO BE PAID, dated May 23, 2024.
  Attachment(s):  Resolution Approving City Warrant Register Dated May 23, 2024

2.  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES OF MAY 14, 2024 (REGULAR)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council approve the regular City Council meeting
  minutes of May 14, 2024.
  Attachment(s):  Draft Regular Meeting Minutes of May 14, 2024

3.  BIENNIAL REVIEW OF THE CITY’S CONFLICT OF INTEREST CODE (FUNDING SOURCE:
  GENERAL FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council direct the City Attorney to review the
  City's Conflict of Interest Code and file a written statement as to the outcome
  of the review with the City Clerk, no later than September 1, 2024.
4.  ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION DETERMINING AND  ESTABLISHING  THE  2024-25
  APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT IN THE AMOUNT OF $52,211,838
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, DETERMINING
  AND ESTABLISHING AN APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT FOR FISCAL YEAR
  2024-25.
  Attachment(s):  Resolution Determining and Establishing the Appropriations Limit
  Tax Receipts Comparison to Appropriation Limit

5.  AWARD OF CONTRACT TO ALL AMERICAN ASPHALT FOR THE CITYWIDE STREET
  RESURFACING PROJECT FOR PUBLIC RESIDENTIAL STREETS LOCATED BETWEEN
  ARROW HIGHWAY AND FOOTHILL BOULEVARD, FROM TOWNE AVENUE TO INDIAN
  HILL BOULEVARD, C.I.P. 2023-3 (FUNDING SOURCE: STATE GAS TAX FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council:
  A. Award a contract to All American Asphalt and authorize the City Manager
  to enter into an agreement with All American Asphalt in the amount of
  $1,808,999, with a project contingency of ten percent ($180,899), for a total
  of $1,989,898 for the Citywide Street Resurfacing Project, C.I.P. No. 2023-3;
  B. Authorize the City Manager to enter into an agreement for inspection
  services and construction management with LAE Associates in the amount of
  $144,564; and
  C. Find this item is exempt from environmental review under the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA).
 Page 4  City Council Agenda  May 28, 2024

6.  AWARD OF CONTRACT TO CT&T CONCRETE PAVING, INC., WE R BUILDERS, INC.,
  AND IE GENERAL ENGINEERING, INC. FOR THE 2023-24 SIDEWALK REHABILITATION
  PROJECT (FUNDING SOURCES: PROPOSITION C FUND AND MEASURE R FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council:
  A. Award a contract to CT&T Concrete Paving, Inc. and authorize the City
  Manager to enter into an agreement with CT&T Concrete Paving, Inc. in the
  amount of $1,094,180, with a project contingency of five percent ($54,709),
  for a total of $1,148,889, to provide sidewalk repair and replacement services
  at identified locations throughout the City (Bid Form A) and Charleston
  Avenue west of Mills Avenue (Bid Form D);
  B. Award a contract to We R Builders, Inc. and authorize the City Manager
  to enter into an agreement with We R Builders, Inc. in the amount of
  $230,000, with a project contingency of five percent ($11,500), for a total of
  $241,500 to provide sidewalk repair and replacement services on the 400
  block of Harvard Avenue (Bid Form B);
  C. Award a contract to IE General Engineering, Inc. and authorize the City
  Manager to enter into an agreement with IE General Engineering, Inc. in the
  amount of $171,000, with a project contingency of five percent ($8,550), for
  a total of $179,550 to provide asphalt repair and replacement services on the
  Padua Avenue Walking Trail (Bid Form C);
  D. Authorize the City Manager to enter into an agreement with RKA
  Consulting Group in the amount of $90,000 for monument preservation;
  E. Appropriate $800,000 from the Proposition C Fund and $447,521.25 from
  the Measure R Fund to fully fund the project; and
  F. Find this item is exempt from environmental review under the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA).
7.  AUTHORIZATION TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH ALL CITY MANAGEMENT
  SERVICES FOR CROSSING GUARD SERVICES (FUNDING SOURCE: GENERAL FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council authorize the City Manager to enter into a
  one-year agreement with All City Management Services for crossing guard
  services, effective July 1, 2024, in an amount not-to-exceed $115,236.
8.  ANNUAL REPORT FOR THE MILITARY EQUIPMENT USE POLICY OF THE CLAREMONT
  POLICE DEPARTMENT AS REQUIRED BY ASSEMBLY BILL 481 - MILITARY EQUIPMENT:
  FUNDING, ACQUISITION, AND USE (FUNDING SOURCE: GENERAL FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council receive and file the Annual Military
  Equipment Report.
  Attachment(s):  Assembly Bill 481 Military Equipment Use Report

PUBLIC HEARINGS - None
 Page 5  City Council Agenda  May 28, 2024

ORDINANCE
9.  CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE THAT, IF ADOPTED, WOULD INCREASE THE
  MONTHLY SALARY RECEIVED BY MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL TO THE AMOUNT
  AUTHORIZED BY SENATE BILL 329 (FUNDING SOURCE: GENERAL FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council:
  A. Consider pay increases for future City Councilmembers in accordance
  with Senate Bill 329; and
  B. If desired, introduce for first reading, and that reading be by title only, AN
  ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT,
  CALIFORNIA, APPROVING A STATUTORY INCREASE IN COMPENSATION
  FOR MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL TO TAKE EFFECT AFTER THE
  NOVEMBER 2024 MUNICIPAL ELECTION.
  Attachment(s):  Ordinance Increasing City Council Compensation

ADMINISTRATIVE ITEM
10. SHORT-TERM RENTAL REGULATIONS STUDY SESSION (FUNDING SOURCE: GENERAL
  FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council:
  A. Provide short-term rental policy direction to staff; and
  B. Direct staff to prepare an ordinance to permit and regulate short-term
  rentals based on City Council policy recommendations.

CONTINUED PUBLIC COMMENT
This time is reserved for those persons who were unable to speak earlier in the agenda because
of the 30-minute time restriction.

COMMISSIONS

  One Police Commission Vacancy
  One Traffic and Transportation Commission Vacancy
  Two Sustainability Committee Vacancies
  One Public Art Committee Vacancy

ADJOURNMENT

THE NEXT REGULAR MEETING OF THE CLAREMONT CITY COUNCIL WILL BE HELD ON
JUNE 11, 2024, AT 6:30 PM, IN THE CLAREMONT COUNCIL CHAMBER, 225 WEST SECOND
STREET, CLAREMONT, CA 91711.
 Page 6  City Council Agenda  May 28, 2024

  June 11, 2024 Regular City Council Meeting, beginning at 6:30 p.m. -
